decisions.reason: A polymer concrete drain housing is a durable installation component that fits the firm's compatible product families and has its own web page, so withdrawing it after one year is unlikely.
Floor-level shower drainage is the firm's core strategic direction, so this system will be kept and developed further.
The designer shower drain supports the firm's design-quality positioning with architects and has a dedicated page, though design lines tend to be refreshed more often.
A shower element with integrated slope matches the trend toward integrated, accessible low-profile systems, even though its web presence is still limited to a mention.
The DallSafe 200 backflow basement drain was presented as a specific new development, and these safety-critical products have long life cycles.
The air-admittance valve is a standard drainage accessory that completes the portfolio at low cost, so it is likely kept despite being a less central product.
